verdict.rationale: Business-filing portals can plausibly offer background automation, such as scheduled or automatic annual-report filing, so this axis applies. The evidence only shows manual, one-off online filings (Express Annual Report, closures, registrations), live chat and a same-day counter. Nothing shows a user-configurable recurring schedule or automation that runs on its own, and the payroll-deduction giving item is unrelated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
